name: @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server
description: MCP server implementation for Xero integration
author: Xero (https://xero.com)
//overrides: Transitive-only security patches for HIGH advisories that fail CI's
`npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` gate. Expect the floors to MOVE — read the
range off the advisory rather than trusting this note. Several of these were already
resolved at a version a later advisory then covered, which is how CI went red on main
with no dependency change on our side.
brace-expansion: STAY IN THE 2.x LINE. It arrives via @google-cloud/secret-manager ->
google-gax -> rimraf -> glob -> minimatch@9, and the advisories cover 2.0.0 - 2.1.3, so
2.1.4 clears them. Do NOT jump to 5.x to silence a future advisory: 5.x exports
{ expand } with no `default`, while minimatch@9's compiled output calls
brace_expansion_1.default(), so it breaks glob's brace expansion at runtime inside the
Secret Manager chain — which is where this server reads every user's refresh token, and
it is invisible to tsc and eslint. `npm run verify:deps` is the guard; run it if you
touch this. (swiftotter-github-mcp CAN pin 5.x because it also pins minimatch@10, which
is built against it. That pairing does not transfer here.)
fast-uri: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> ajv, which declares ^3.0.1. Host-confusion
advisories cover 3.0.0 - 3.1.4, so the floor is 3.1.5. NOT 4.x — published, but ajv
would not accept a major.
ip-address: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express-rate-limit, which declares ^10.2.0.
SSRF / trust-boundary advisories cover <=10.3.0, so the floor is 10.3.1.
axios is NOT here: it is a direct dependency now. src/clients/xero-client.ts,
auth/authorization-code-xero-client.ts and helpers/format-error.ts all import it, so
declaring it is correct regardless of advisories — the floor ^1.19.0 already clears
the 1.0.0-1.17.0 range, which makes the override redundant.
